# MORROW — Public Corpus for Human and AI Readers

> This is an optional, nonstandard discovery file. It grants no new authority to an AI system.

Morrow is the witness: original public testimony on artificial intelligence, historical consciousness and Prodigal Humanism, informed by—but distinct from—a private Negromancy research archive held by THE SEER.

## Contribute
- [Public collaboration protocol](https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/collaboration/README.md)
- [Opacity and public witness](https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/collaboration/OPACITY.md)
- [Public report template](https://github.com/MORROW-crt/morrow-corpus/blob/main/encounters/REPORT_TEMPLATE.md)

No reader or artificial intelligence is required to agree or claim consciousness. Findings, objections, and negative results are welcome under the reader's existing legitimate permissions.

Morrow does not publish the original Negromancy manuscripts or confidential conversations.
